title: Laravel: Refreshing Artisan
content: <html><head></head><body>On today's release of Laravel v9.21.0, we’re bringing you a fresh new look for Artisan: a brand new console output on the vast majority of Laravel commands that deliveries a better console experience, and displays more information in commands such as "migrate" or "queue:work".</body></html>
author: Nuno Maduro
